turns.content: I need a confident, professional LinkedIn post for the Fujifilm X100VI. It's a compact camera with a hybrid viewfinder and a 23mmF2 lens. Keep it under 80 words.

I created the draft and validated it against the confirmed product facts and requested constraints.

Introducing the Fujifilm X100VI, a compact camera designed for professionals. With its innovative hybrid viewfinder, you can effortlessly switch between optical and electronic views. The 23mm F2 lens delivers stunning image quality, making it an essential tool for photographers on the go. Elevate your photography with the X100VI.
